name: zvideo_get_display_mode_bpp
description: zVideo::GetDisplayModeBpp returns the cached display-mode bits-per-pixel value.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call profile; behavior is covered by the direct zVideo display-mode BPP getter smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a66e0 validates a leaf read of g_zVideo_DisplayModeBpp.
The native zVideo getter smoke saves and restores g_zVideo_DisplayModeBpp, sets 16-bit and 8-bit display depths, and verifies GetDisplayModeBpp returns the cached value.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a66e0 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob1_md_facs; BN size 6, VC object symbol size 16, 10 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
